# apple_analytics_reports (Data Source)

Lists the reports App Store Connect generated for an analytics report request. The list is empty until the first reports are ready, one to two days after the request.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_analytics_reports" "sessions" {
  request_id = apple_analytics_report_request.ongoing.id
  names      = ["App Sessions Standard"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `request_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the request, e.g. `apple_analytics_report_request.example.id`.

### Optional

- `categories` (Set of String) Categories to list. Values: `APP_USAGE`, `APP_STORE_ENGAGEMENT`, `COMMERCE`, `FRAMEWORK_USAGE`, `PERFORMANCE`.
- `names` (Set of String) Names of the reports to list, e.g. `App Sessions Standard`.

### Read-Only

- `reports` (Attributes List) The reports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reports))

<a id="nestedatt--reports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reports`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category of the report: `APP_USAGE`, `APP_STORE_ENGAGEMENT`, `COMMERCE`, `FRAMEWORK_USAGE`, `PERFORMANCE`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the report.
- `name` (String) Name of the report.
